features.title: Run a team of AI models as a fellowship
steps: Run `mithril fellowship init` to set up a fellowship.
Run `mithril fellowships` to list available fellowships.
Run `mithril fellowship status` to see the current fellowship.

features.feature: serve Ollama, OpenAI and MCP API endpoints
features.title: Serve Ollama, OpenAI and MCP API endpoints
steps: Start the server with `mithril serve --port 16180` and check it with `curl -s http://localhost:16180/health`.
List models on the OpenAI-style endpoint with `curl -s http://localhost:16180/v1/models`.
List MCP tools with `curl -s -X POST http://localhost:16180/mcp -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"tools/list","params":{}}'`.

setup.command: mithril fellowship init 2>&1; echo "---EXIT:$?"; ls -R .mithril 2>&1; cat .mithril/fellowship.yaml 2>&1

smoke_tests.command: python3 -c "import json,urllib.request; d=json.dumps({'jsonrpc':'2.0','id':1,'method':'tools/list','params':{}}).encode(); r=urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request('http://localhost:16180/mcp',data=d,headers={'Content-Type':'application/json'}),timeout=10); j=json.loads(r.read()); tools=j.get('result',{}).get('tools',j.get('result',[])); print('tool_count:', len(tools)); print('names:', sorted([t.get('name') for t in tools]))"
